title: Фотография из холодильника
content: Use the uploaded photo as the character. A POV shot from inside an open refrigerator, extreme wide-angle/fisheye, with the subject leaning in and reaching toward the camera, fingers slightly distorted. Bright, cool fridge lighting, messy everyday food items in the foreground, and raw early-2000s snapshot energy with slight noise and unpolished realism.
